items.title: Mike Longo interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 13, 2019
items.q: Dizzy took me to Lalo Schifrin’s home for dinner.

ctx.x: And Dizzy asked me once, on an airplane, he said, “Man, how do you be so prolific?” And I’m saying why is he asking me that, I never wrote anything like “Con Alma” or something like that. Then I realized he was serious. So I said sometimes I’ll be looking at the piano and I’ll just go over and play a chord. Other times I’ll hear a melody in my head. Another time I’ll be thinking of a rhythm and a melody starts to happen. And at one point Dizzy took me to Lalo Schifrin’s home for dinner. And I was just with him…
